title: Page 8
content_zh:
听听，多霸气的宣示。
不过，她喜欢。
“全听你的。”她灿笑如花的贴着他肩膀。
最好是。
他低头看她，而后笑开，再次覆上她唇。
迎亲大队再次出发时间，已是二月二八，距离初一的婚期根本来不及。好在皇上圣明早早想到这点，在派下李进同时，也遣出信使到襄州，改将婚期挪到同月二十。
在大匹勇将紧紧护卫下，这次行程再没贼匪来袭。连走了七天，队伍终于来到襄州，来离城门有些距离，便能听见此起彼落的鞭炮与欢呼声。
乘在软轿上的于季友微笑，回到家的感觉，还真是好。
一进城都，立见于季友他爹于□，于□下跪迎驾。
跟在他身后的，是一列威武英挺的驻兵。
“山南东道节度使于□，见过普宁公主。”
一皓腕从重重帷幕中伸出。“于大人快请起。”
“谢普宁公主。”于□起身，示意执役带队到布置好的行馆，让公主好好歇息。
于季友一行人，则是跟在于□马车后边，朝自家府邸行去。
一进门，于□就忙着检查儿子身体。
“听说你受伤了？”
“好多了，再几天应该就没事了。”于季友答。“对了爹，皇上还不无下旨决定婚期？”
“你自个儿看。”
于季友一见诏书，脸都绿了。算算，还有近十五天时间，才能将普宁娶进家门！
“怎么，到现在你还在埋怨爹帮你定了这门亲？”于□错把儿子的迫不及待，当成不情愿。

“不是。”于季友一瞥立在身旁的佣仆，手一挥待他们离开，他才把这些日子心头的转折，一一吐露。
于□听得又惊又喜。“你没诓爹？真的是普宁公主自愿为你洗衣担水挑柴？”
“孩儿诓爹做什么？”于季友觉得好笑。“公主真的变了，现在孩儿非常感谢爹，要不是您当时神来一笔跟皇上求亲，孩儿也不会了解自个儿娶了个多棒的姑娘。”
“原来你刚是在懊恼婚期被延得太久？！”于□大笑。“爹真没想到。”
“爹。”
“好好好，爹不糗你。”于□知道儿子背伤，只敢轻拍他肩膀安慰。“这几天你就好好休息，赶快把背伤养好。放心，十五天忍一下就过去了。”
忍？于季友暗吐口气，要说他此刻最讨厌听见什么，没别的，一定是这个字。
正所谓度日如年，对他来说，这十五天忍耐的日子，要比他的背被砍伤还难捱百倍。
总归一句，皇命难为。他再讨厌等，也只能按他爹说的－－忍。
行馆这头，普宁自李进嘴里听见她父王命令，倒没像于季友那般难耐。
毕竟她没忘记，她未来夫君背上，还有个未愈的刀伤。
多等个十五天也好，她想，这样一来，待他俩成亲，他的伤也该好了。
可她忘了，相思难耐。
才一个日夜，她已经左思右念想他想得不得了。可碍于礼俗，又不能像先前在路上，动辄要女官跟胡里帮他们安排见面的机会。行馆守备隶属朝廷，要找不到合适理由，别说普宁出不去，就连于季友也进不来。
实在无法可想，两人只好写信互诉衷曲，胡里与女官们当成了信鸽，日日为对方捎来信息。
于季友写来第一封信，是抄自《诗经》，〈东方之日〉，说的是他昨晚作的梦。
东方之日兮，彼妹者子，在我室兮；在我室兮，履我即兮。
诗的意思是大清早，心爱的姑娘偷偷跑进房里与情人相会，但实际上普宁并没造访，所以于季友醒来发现只是梦，他怅然若失之情，溢于言衷。
普宁回他两句诗－－
纵我不往，子宁不来？

于季友一见信箴，笑了。
明白地说，她没过去，难道他就不能来么？
于季友再回信。
蒹葭苍苍，白露为霜。所谓伊人，在水一方。溯洄从之，道阻且长；溯游从之，宛在水中央。
他说，他很想去啊，想得不得了。问题是她所在之地，戒备森严，他已经试了好几天，还是想不到法子潜入。
普宁读了信，不消说，失望至极。
头一回她讨厌自己的公主身份，非得要让人这么重重保护着。尤其她心腹李进已回京覆命，如果他在，她还能死缠活缠逼他帮忙。
当晚，普宁在女官们的伺候下洗了个香澡。望着咕噜咕噜冒泡的温泉，她忽然想起一首白居易的诗。
隔天，于季友从胡里手上拿到这封信－－
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
见之，他捧头呻吟。
这丫头，竟用这种方式逗他。
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
温泉水滑洗凝脂－－遥想那画面的于季友深吸口黑，积累了数日的相思，几要教他失去理智。
他想吻她的小嘴，想把那香馥馥、软滑滑身子搂在胸前，想跟她耳鬓厮磨，想听她娇嫩嫩地喊他夫君……但是他、他这会儿却只能坐在自个儿卧房，想像她新承恩泽时的娇态。
“可恶。”他捂脸低斥，恨不得背上能长出协膀，啪啪啪飞到她身边去。
“彼采艾兮，一日不见，如三岁兮。”于季友吟道。
好在已过了十日，现下只要再忍五天。于季友诚心祈求老天，绝对、绝对不要再发生任何变故。
他只想平平安安娶回普宁，与之偕老，直到白头。
第10章(1)

公主与城中少主大婚当日，襄阳城民家家户户张灯结彩，逢人便道：“恭喜恭喜”，简直把娶公主的事，当成了自家的荣耀。
由此可见于家之得民心。
三月二十吉时，普宁所乘的珠花彩轿开始沿着襄阳大街慢行，一时鼓乐、鞭炮齐响，七八十数的仪杖罗列，还有后边嫁奁的队伍与随行护卫，场面之堂皇富丽，足教襄阳居民传颂好一阵。
彩轿一到，于家众亲全欢狂了。大伙儿盼的就这一刻，能近身瞧瞧皇帝的掌上明珠是何等雍容华贵。女官们掀红帘，领下罩着盖头的普宁，走在她身旁着红衫绒冠的于季友显得格外英挺。两人共执红缎，走进大堂拜天地。
当晚，婚宴水席开了数百桌，将于宅里外挤得水泄不通，于季友费了好些功夫才抽开身。一到新房，他立刻撩开普宁的盖头，在女官们的祝祷声中，两人喝完了交杯酒。
他笑着帮普宁摘下凤冠。
一头青丝绾上新妇发髻的普宁无比秀雅，衬着大红色霞帔的雪白肌肤，直像初综的白牡丹般粉艳动人。
直到这时，他心袖千觉得踏实。早一刻，他还提点胡里多注意里外，就怕再发生什么突发情况，扰了他俩的结合之路。
要知道，他等这天，等得心多焦。
女官们撤下桌上的甜汤空碗，门一关上，于季友立刻抱住普宁。
“贤妻啊贤妻，这十五天，真是想煞我也。”
“我也想你。”脸埋在他坚实的怀中，普宁低声回话。
这空隔十五天的相思，一来是苦，二来，也更是坚定两人厮守的信念－－再见之后两人同时明白，能让自己心头不再感觉空缺的灵药，唯有眼前人。
“说到这，我要跟你好好算算这几天的帐。你写来那什么信啊！都不晓得我读的人的感受。”
“什么感受？”普宁佯装无辜地问，一根指头还在他胸口勾着画着。
“焦渴难耐。”像是要证明燃在他胸口的那把火，究竟有多猛，他托起她脸，贴住她嘴反覆厮磨。
普宁欣喜地勾住他脖子－－这早是她夜里不知作过几回的美梦，如今成真，怎么可能不立即臣服在他给予的欢愉之中。
content_en:
Listen, what a domineering declaration.
However, she likes it.
"It's all up to you." She leaned against his shoulder with a bright smile.
It better be.
He looked down at her, then smiled and covered her lips again.
It was already February 28th when the wedding team set off again, which was too late for the wedding date on the first day of the lunar month. Fortunately, Emperor Shengming had thought of this early. While sending Li Jin, he also sent a messenger to Xiangzhou and changed the wedding date to the twentieth of the same month.
Under the tight protection of the brave generals, there were no more bandits on this trip. After walking for seven days, the team finally arrived in Xiangzhou. Some distance away from the city gate, they could hear the rising and falling of firecrackers and cheers.
Yu Jiyou, who was riding in the soft sedan, smiled. It felt really good to be home.
As soon as he entered the city, he immediately saw Yu Jiyou's father, Yu □, who knelt down to greet him.
Behind him was a line of mighty and heroic garrison troops.
"Yu □, the envoy of the Eastern Province of Shannan Province, met Princess Puning."
A bright wrist stretched out from the heavy curtains. "Master Yu, please get up quickly."
"Princess Xie Puning." Yu □ stood up and motioned to the executive to lead the team to the arranged hotel so that the princess could have a good rest.
Yu Jiyou and his party followed Yu's carriage and headed towards their residence.
As soon as he entered the door, Yu □ was busy checking his son's body.
"I heard you were injured?"
"Much better, he should be fine in a few days." Yu Jiyou replied. "By the way, dad, the emperor has not issued a decree to determine the wedding date?"
"See for yourself."
When Yu Jiyou saw the edict, his face turned green. Calculating, there are still nearly fifteen days before Puning can be married into the family!
"Why, you are still complaining that dad helped you arrange this marriage?" Yu Cuo mistook his son's eagerness for reluctance.
"No." Yu Jiyou glanced at the servants standing beside him, waved his hand and waited for them to leave, then he revealed the twists and turns in his heart these days.
Yu □ was surprised and happy when he heard this. "You didn't lie to me? Is it really Princess Puning who volunteered to carry water and firewood for you to do your laundry?"
"What are you kidding your father for?" Yu Jiyou found it funny. "The princess has really changed. Now I am very grateful to my father. If you hadn't made a sudden move to propose marriage to the emperor, I would not have known what a wonderful girl I married."
"So you were just upset that the wedding was postponed for too long?!" Yu □ laughed. "Dad really didn't expect that."
"Dad."
"Okay, okay, Dad won't embarrass you." Yu □ knew that his son's back was injured, so he only dared to pat his shoulder to comfort him. "You should have a good rest these days and heal your back injury as soon as possible. Don't worry, it will pass in just fifteen days."
Tolerate? Yu Jiyou secretly sighed, if he had to say what he hated hearing the most at the moment, and nothing else, it would definitely be this word.
As the saying goes, every day is like a year. For him, these fifteen days of endurance were a hundred times harder than having his back slashed.
In short, the emperor's life is difficult. No matter how much he hates waiting, he can only do as his father said - endure it.
At the other end of the hotel, Puning heard her father's order from Li Jin, but she was not as impatient as Yu Jiyou.
After all, she had not forgotten that her future husband still had an unhealed stab wound on his back.
It would be better to wait fifteen more days, she thought. In this way, by the time they get married, his injury should be healed.
But she forgot, she was lovesick.
It had only been a day and night, but she had already thought about him so much. But due to etiquette and customs, they couldn't always ask the female officer and Hu Li to help them arrange meetings like before on the road. The garrison of the hotel belongs to the imperial court. If there is no suitable reason, not only Puning will not be able to get out, but even Yu Jiyou will not be able to get in.
It was impossible to think about it, so the two had no choice but to write letters to each other to express their feelings. Hu Li and the female officials became carrier pigeons, bringing messages to each other every day.
The first letter written by Yu Jiyou was copied from "The Book of Songs", "Eastern Sun", and it was about the dream he had last night.
The sun is shining in the east, and that sister's son is coming to my room; he is coming to my room, and he is walking by me.
The meaning of the poem is that early in the morning, the beloved girl sneaks into the roomMeeting his lover, but in fact Puning did not visit, so when Yu Jiyou woke up and found that it was just a dream, he felt so disappointed that he could not express his feelings.
Puning replied with two lines of poetry -
Even if I don't go, Zi Ning won't come?
When Yu Jiyou saw Xinzhen, he smiled.
To put it plainly, if she didn't go there, couldn't he come?
Yu Jiyou wrote again.
The jianjia is green and the white dew is frost. The so-called beauty is on the water side. If you follow it back, the road is blocked and long; if you follow it, you will wander in the middle of the water.
He said that he really wanted to go, it was so exciting. The problem is that the place where she is is heavily guarded. He has been trying for several days and still can't think of a way to sneak in.
Puning read the letter and was, needless to say, extremely disappointed.
For the first time, she hated her status as a princess and having to be protected so heavily. Especially since her confidant Li Jin has returned to Beijing to take orders. If he were here, she could still pester him to help.
That night, Puning took a fragrant bath under the care of female officials. Looking at the bubbling hot springs, she suddenly remembered a poem by Bai Juyi.
The next day, Yu Jiyou got this letter from Hu Li -
[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]
Seeing this, he held his head and groaned.
This girl actually teased him in this way.
[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]
The hot spring water washes away the fat - Yu Jiyou took a deep breath as he thought about that scene. The lovesickness accumulated for several days almost made him lose his mind.
He wanted to kiss her little mouth, hold that fragrant and soft body to his chest, want to rub her ears and temples, and hear her tenderly call him husband... But he, he could only sit in his bedroom at the moment, imagining her coquettish look when she was newly blessed.
"Damn it." He muttered, covering his face, wishing he could grow wings on his back and fly to her side.
"He is picking mugwort. If I don't see him for a day, I feel like he is three years old." Yu Jiyou chanted.
Fortunately, ten days have passed, and now I only need to endure it for five more days. Yu Jiyou sincerely prays to God that absolutely, absolutely nothing will happen again.
He just wants to marry Puning in peace and grow old together with her until they grow old together.
Chapter 10(1)
On the wedding day of the princess and the young master of the city, every household in Xiangyang City was decorated with lanterns and colorful decorations. They greeted everyone: "Congratulations," and they regarded marrying the princess as their own glory.
This shows how popular Yu Jia is.
On the 20th of the auspicious day of March, Puning's colorful sedan with pearls and flowers began to move slowly along Xiangyang Street. Drums and firecrackers were blaring, and dozens of ceremonial sticks were lined up. There were also a dowry team and accompanying guards behind. The scene was so majestic and magnificent that it was enough for Xiangyang residents to sing the praises for a while.
As soon as the colorful sedan arrived, all the relatives in the Yu family were wildly rejoicing. This is the moment that everyone has been looking forward to, to get a closer look at how graceful and luxurious the jewel in the emperor's eye is. The female officials lifted the red curtain and led Puning, who was wearing a hijab, and Yu Jiyou, who was walking beside her and wearing a red velvet hat, looked particularly handsome. The two held red satin together and walked into the lobby to worship heaven and earth.
That night, hundreds of wedding banquet tables were opened, and it was so crowded inside and outside Yu's house that it took Yu Jiyou a long time to get away. As soon as he arrived at the new house, he immediately lifted Punin's hijab, and amidst the blessings of the female officials, the two drank and exchanged glasses of wine.
He smiled and helped Puning take off the phoenix crown.
Puning, with her bridal bun tied up in green silk silk, is extremely elegant. Against her snow-white skin, which is brightly red, she looks as pink and beautiful as a newly bloomed white peony.
Until then, he felt at ease. A moment earlier, he had reminded Hu Li to pay more attention inside and outside, just because he was afraid that something unexpected would happen again and disturb their union.
You know, he was very anxious waiting for this day.
The female officials removed the empty bowls of sweet soup from the table. As soon as the door closed, Yu Jiyou immediately hugged Puning.
"Good wife, good wife, these fifteen days, you have really tried to kill me."
"I miss you too." Puning whispered back with her face buried in his solid arms.
The longing for each other after fifteen days was painful on the one hand, but also determined on the other to stay together.Faith - after seeing each other again, the two of them understood at the same time that the only elixir that could make their hearts no longer feel empty was the person in front of them.
"Speaking of which, I want to settle the accounts with you over the past few days. What kind of letter did you write? I don't know how the people I read feel."
"How do you feel?" Puning asked pretending to be innocent, still tracing a finger on his chest.
"The thirst is unbearable." As if to prove how strong the fire burning in his chest was, he held up her face, pressed it against her mouth and rubbed it repeatedly.
Puning happily hooked her arms around his neck - this had been a sweet dream she had had countless times at night, and now that it had come true, how could she not immediately surrender to the pleasure he gave her.
